recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the applied FHIR-31830 decision for the current build; review FHIR-31780/FHIR-31790 separately if their remaining medication-definition artifacts still need reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-31830 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested that SubstanceSpecification/SubstanceDefinition status elements such as status, code.status, name.status, and name.official.status use standard draft/active/retired/unknown codes, with cardinality 1..1 and isModifier=true.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly naming FHIR-31830 was found, and both the R5 history and current source still showed the four SubstanceDefinition status elements as optional CodeableConcept fields with preferred PublicationStatus bindings. The issue therefore had not been fully applied to current source.
additional_context: SubstanceSpecification is represented in the current build as the active BRR SubstanceDefinition resource. BRR minutes record the FHIR-31830 vote, and related status issues FHIR-31780/FHIR-31790 establish the same required code/PublicationStatus pattern for neighboring medication-definition resources, but those separate artifacts were not decided here.
reconciliation: Updated source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml so SubstanceDefinition.status, code.status, name.status, and name.official.status are 1..1 code elements with required PublicationStatus bindings and common-binding metadata; added modifier metadata to the nested status elements. Updated source/substancedefinition/substancedefinition-example.xml to use active code statuses and include the now-required code.status.
source_changes: source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml: made SubstanceDefinition.status, SubstanceDefinition.code.status, SubstanceDefinition.name.status, and SubstanceDefinition.name.official.status required code elements with required PublicationStatus bindings and modifier metadata.
source/substancedefinition/substancedefinition-example.xml: replaced CodeableConcept status examples with code value="active" and added code.status value="active".

related_jiras.note: Companion Published BRR issue that added required draft/active/retired/unknown status codes to AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and Ingredient.
